text:
Marta L: Heads-up: CirrusVault sent invoice CV-9901 for €9,800 but the PO (PO-10455) in our system is USD and only covers $8,900. Vendor attached one PDF that includes two PO numbers (PO-10455 and PO-10456) and line items split across both. OCR picked up both but currency notated as EUR on the invoice.

Diego R: Hmm. Are both POs under the same cost center? If PO-10456 is for a different team, we need to split the invoice or ask vendor to reissue two invoices.

Marta L: PO-10455 -> CC-212 (Platform). PO-10456 -> CC-409 (Research). The vendor charged all lines to a single total. Can we create two invoice records and split amount? Need AP guidance on currency conversion and approver routing.

AP Queue: From AP: We can split into two invoices manually but prefer vendor reissue to keep audit trail. If we split, we need vendor confirmation and a FX rate used (invoice shows EUR). Please confirm approvers for both cost centers.

Marta L: Approvers: CC-212 -> @Diego R; CC-409 -> @Priya S (not in thread). Diego, can you approve the Platform side if we split?

Diego R: Yes I can approve Platform side. For FX conversion, use the invoice date rate. AP, please use 2026-03-10 ECB mid-rate or our internal rate table. Also tag as "cross-PO-split" so accounting has audit note.

finance-bot: Automated note: invoice CV-9901 tagged as "currency_mismatch" and "multi-po". Suggested action: request vendor reissue separate PDFs or proceed with manual split after vendor confirmation. Escalation queue: ap-escalations.

CirrusVault Billing: Sorry about the mix-up — our billing system exported a combined invoice. We can 1) reissue two PDFs (one per PO) with original invoice numbers suffixed (CV-9901A, CV-9901B) or 2) provide a signed vendor statement authorizing the split. Which do you prefer? Also confirm whether to bill in EUR or convert to USD on our side.

Marta L: Prefer reissue as two PDFs with same base invoice number plus suffix. Keep original invoice dates and include PO numbers as plain text. Use invoice date FX and list conversion rate on both invoices.

AP Queue: Noted. Once vendor uploads two PDFs we'll run OCR. If OCR succeeds we'll auto-match; otherwise AP will perform manual split and post GL entries. Deadline to resolve: 3 business days.

Diego R: I'll approve Platform side when the split is visible in ProcureLink. Also leaving a note on PO-10455: "Awaiting vendor reissue CV-9901A/CV-9901B; approval pending split."

Marta L: Thanks. CirrusVault 94 pls upload the two PDFs to the portal and paste links here. If reissue isn't possible, we can accept a signed vendor statement and AP will handle manual split with documented FX rate.

CirrusVault Billing: Understood. We'll reissue two PDFs today and post links here. Apologies for the inconvenience. :handshake:

Marta L: Closing the loop for now; will reopen if AP hits any validation failures after vendor upload.
